id: title:jurajmajerik:add breathing room to replay vision checkbox in wizard

review.posthog_relevance: Frontend presentation change in the Experiment Wizard, potentially improving readability of the 'Watch participant behavior with Replay Vision' section.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 shows a localized frontend presentation change: increasing vertical padding and adding top margin to a subtitle paragraph. This is a bounded, cosmetic improvement to the Experiment Wizard UI. No backend, security, or systemic reliability changes are present. The benefit is plausible but not demonstrated by broader context.
review.uncertainty: This score relies solely on a single hunk; no relationship to other hunks or broader change context is established. The actual user benefit depends on the overall layout and is not demonstrated by this isolated spacing change.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only a single hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between this hunk and other potential changes can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: The label's vertical padding changed from 'py-1' to 'py-3', and a margin-top class 'mt-1' was added to the subtitle paragraph, increasing the visual spacing between the label and the descriptive text.
observations.posthog_connection: This is a frontend presentation change, potentially improving readability of the 'Watch participant behavior with Replay Vision' section in the Experiment Wizard, though the exact user benefit depends on the overall layout and is not demonstrated by this isolated spacing change.
